Observational genome and clinical phenotyping in Parkinson and REM sleep behavior disorder; no assigned broccoli intervention.
Memory strategy training and prospective memory measures; no broccoli exposure.
Methylphenidate versus placebo and psychosocial intervention for apathy; no cherry exposure.
Piperine solutions in oropharyngeal dysphagia; swallow safety and efficacy; isolated compound is not ground black pepper food and disease cohort not established as Parkinson.
Pharyngeal piperine and other sensory solutions versus placebo in older adults with dysphagia; penetration-aspiration and timing outcomes; not culinary black pepper or speech intelligibility.
Piperine or capsaicin plus transcranial stimulation in post-stroke dysphagia; swallowing and spontaneous swallowing frequency, not Parkinson speech or culinary pepper.

Multioil omega supplement contains rosemary extract antioxidant; adolescent learning and attention, no Parkinson fresh-rosemary walking outcome.
